name: Rubico Prime — One-Shot Steel Path
description: The classic Steel Path delete button. Huge crit multiplier plus Hunter Munitions slash procs that ignore armor — one zoomed headshot, one dead heavy gunner.
playstyle: Zoom in for the crit bonus, aim for heads. Keep Primary Deadhead stacked by chaining headshot kills. Swap the Bane per faction.

mods.name: Primed Chamber
mods.note: +100% damage on the first shot in the mag

mods.name: Vigilante Armaments
mods.note: Multishot + set bonus crit upgrade chance

mods.name: Hunter Munitions
mods.note: Slash procs on crits — the one-shot engine

name: Vectis Prime — One-Shot Steel Path
description: One bullet, one kill. Primed Chamber turns its single-round magazine into a nuke, and the crit stats do the rest.
playstyle: Reload after every shot to keep Primed Chamber active. Zoom, headshot, repeat. Bring ammo restores for long missions.

mods.name: Primed Chamber
mods.note: Doubles the one bullet in the mag

mods.name: Hunter Munitions
mods.note: Slash procs on crits ignore armor

name: Lanka — One-Shot Steel Path
description: Charge it, delete them. Viral plus Hunter Munitions slash melts armor-scaled Steel Path heavies in a single charged shot.
playstyle: Full-charge every shot — half charges waste the build. Cold + toxin = Viral; slash procs finish what the bullet starts.

mods.name: Rime Rounds
mods.note: Cold — pairs with toxin for Viral

mods.name: Malignant Force
mods.note: Toxin — pairs with cold for Viral

name: Sporothrix — One-Shot Steel Path
description: A crit sniper with a nasty status kicker. Critical Delay pushes crit chance sky-high while Hunter Munitions bleeds out whatever survives the bullet.
playstyle: Scope in, land crits, let slash procs work. The fire-rate penalty from Critical Delay barely matters on a sniper.

name: Fragor Prime — One-Shot Slam
description: The original one-shot hammer. A fully wound-up heavy slam turns Steel Path crowds into red mist.
playstyle: Build combo with a few light hits or Corrupt Charge's flat bonus, then heavy slam into the pack. Jump-slam for extra AoE.

mods.name: Amalgam Organ Shatter
mods.note: More crit damage + heavy attack speed

mods.name: Corrupt Charge
mods.note: +60% heavy attack damage, -combo efficiency you won't miss

name: Reaper Prime — One-Shot Heavy Slash
description: Heavy attacks with forced slash procs. One heavy swing bleeds out Steel Path heavies while you walk away.
playstyle: Heavy attack into groups — the slash procs ignore armor. Keep moving; the bleeds finish the job.

mods.name: Amalgam Organ Shatter
mods.note: More crit damage + heavy attack speed

mods.name: Corrupt Charge
mods.note: +60% heavy attack damage, -combo efficiency you won't miss

name: Gram Prime — One-Shot Heavy
description: Big sword, bigger numbers. Heavy attack crits with this much crit damage one-shot nearly anything in Steel Path.
playstyle: Charge heavies into the densest pack. Primed Reach keeps you safe at range.

mods.name: Amalgam Organ Shatter
mods.note: More crit damage + heavy attack speed

mods.name: Corrupt Charge
mods.note: +60% heavy attack damage, -combo efficiency you won't miss

name: Arca Titron — One-Shot Slam
description: Built to slam. Seismic Wave supercharges slam attacks, and the heavy multipliers turn every slam into an earthquake.
playstyle: Slam, slam, slam. Aim for the middle of packs — the shockwave does the rest.

name: Innodem — One-Shot Incarnon Dagger
description: Tiny dagger, absurd crit. Incarnon form plus Blood Rush crit scaling one-shots Steel Path elites on heavy attacks.
playstyle: Charge Incarnon, build combo fast with the attack speed, then heavy attack priority targets.

name: Ceramic Dagger — One-Shot Incarnon
description: The Incarnon dagger that punches way above its weight. Crit-stacked heavies delete Steel Path heavies.
playstyle: Build combo, go Incarnon, heavy attack the biggest threat in the room.

name: Torid — Incarnon Beam
description: The beam that broke the meta. Viral + Hunter Munitions slash on a chaining beam melts Steel Path rooms.
playstyle: Charge Incarnon, sweep the beam across packs. Cold + toxin = Viral; slash procs ignore armor.

name: Bubonico — Arm Cannon
description: Shotgun-arm-cannon hybrid. Viral + slash in alt-fire mode turns hallways into kill zones.
playstyle: Primary fire for groups, alt-fire for single targets. Keep Hunter Munitions rolling for armor ignore.

mods.name: Primed Point Blank
mods.note: Base damage — the foundation of every shotgun build

mods.name: Galvanized Hell
mods.note: Multishot that stacks into huge damage on kills

name: Ignis Wraith — Corrosive Hose
description: Point, hold trigger, everything dies. Corrosive strips armor while heat keeps the damage ticking.
playstyle: Sweep the beam across crowds. Heat + toxin + electric gives you broad status coverage against everything.

name: Amprex — Chain Lightning
description: The original chain beam. Crit + corrosive arcs clear entire rooms from a single target.
playstyle: Shoot one enemy in a pack and let the arcs do the work. Tight corridors are your best friend.

name: Tenet Glaxion — Viral Beam
description: Freezes and shreds. Viral halves enemy health pools while slash procs finish armored targets.
playstyle: Hold the beam on heavies. Cold + toxin = Viral — the progenitor toxin does half the work for you.
progenitor: Toxin (combines with the cold mod for Viral)

name: Cedo — Status Primer
description: The best primer in the game. Glaive throws every status in the book, then the shotgun finishes primed targets.
playstyle: Throw the glaive into packs to stack statuses, then mop up with primary fire's bonus damage vs status'd enemies.

name: Dual Toxocyst — Incarnon Frenzy
description: Headshots turn it into a machine gun. Incarnon form with viral melts Steel Path at fire rates that break the game.
playstyle: Land headshots to trigger the frenzy, then hold trigger. Cold + toxin = Viral keeps everything soft.

name: Onos — Corrosive Beam
description: A pocket Amprex. Corrosive strips armor off Steel Path heavies while crits keep the numbers huge.
playstyle: Sweep across packs. Electric + toxin = Corrosive — armor stops mattering fast.

name: Kuva Nukor — Status Primer
description: Four statuses per trigger pull. Nothing primes a target faster — your other weapons do double duty after this.
playstyle: Paint priority targets with the beam, then swap to your main weapon for the kill. Magnetic progenitor adds a fifth status.

name: Epitaph — AoE Primer
description: Charged shots blanket rooms in status. The uncharged tap still hits like a truck for cleanup.
playstyle: Charge into packs for the AoE primer, tap-fire stragglers. Viral + heat + electric covers everything.

name: Kompressa — Viral Hose
description: Viral on tap with crit to back it up. One of the most comfortable Steel Path secondaries ever made.
playstyle: Hold trigger and sweep. Cold + toxin = Viral; Galvanized Shot rewards the status stacking.

name: Venka Prime — Combo Monster
description: The x13 combo multiplier turns every hit into a truck. Condition Overload scales it into Steel Path endgame.
playstyle: Build combo and never let it drop. Weeping Wounds + Condition Overload = more damage the longer you fight.

name: Sampotes — Incarnon Fists
description: Incarnon fists with combo scaling. Fast, brutal, and it keeps up with Steel Path scaling for a long time.
playstyle: Charge Incarnon early, keep the combo rolling. Punch through packs — the range surprises people.

name: Okina Prime — Incarnon Daggers
description: Dual daggers that scale forever. Combo + status + crit in one package that never falls off.
playstyle: Build combo on trash, spend it on heavies. Drifting Contact keeps your combo alive between packs.

name: Galatine Prime — Speed Crit
description: The classic greatsword, modernized. Crit + speed + range turns it into a Steel Path lawnmower.
playstyle: Spin through packs. Berserker Fury keeps you at max speed once crits start landing.

name: Kullervo — Melee God
description: Wrathful Advance teleports you to enemies with a guaranteed crit buff, and the strength stacking makes every melee swing a nuke.
playstyle: Cast Wrathful Advance, teleport-strike priority targets. Storm of Ukko groups enemies first for maximum carnage.

name: Dante — Noctua Support
description: The bard that keeps everyone alive. Overguard on demand, damage buffs, and enough strength to make it all count.
playstyle: Keep Triumph and Wordwarden cycling for the team. Build strength so your buffs and damage actually matter.

name: Jade — Glory Nuke
description: Light of Judgment rains judgment. Strength + range turns her 4 into a room-clearing nuke with team support baked in.
playstyle: Pop Glory of Judgment in big rooms, keep moving. The damage scales with strength — don't skimp on it.

name: Citrine — Crystal Support
description: Prisms, healing, and status immunity for the whole squad. The support frame that makes Steel Path feel fair.
playstyle: Keep Fractured Blast and Preserving Shell up. Strength makes your crystals hit harder and protect better.

name: Voruna — Stealth Melee
description: Invisible, fast, lethal. Lycath's Hunt keeps you cloaked while status-spread melee deletes packs.
playstyle: Stay invisible, spread status with melee, let the pack hunt itself. Strength feeds everything.

name: Styanax — Spear Nuke
description: Tharros Strike groups them, Axios Javelineers delete them. Strength + range = entire rooms gone in two casts.
playstyle: Group with Tharros Strike, nuke with spears. Keep energy flowing — this build is hungry.

name: Gyre — Electric Nuke
description: Cathode Grace turns every crit into an electric storm. Strength + range keeps the lightning rolling across Steel Path packs.
playstyle: Keep Cathode Grace active, crit everything. The electric procs chain through crowds on their own.

name: Qorvex — Radiation Tank
description: A walking reactor. Radiation status confuses enemies into killing each other while you stand in the middle of it all.
playstyle: Keep Containment Wall cycling, let radiation do the crowd control. Built to face-tank what it can't confuse.
